init_breakable_cuda_graph_runner: initialize a BreakableCudaGraphRunner instance with a ModelRunner to capture CUDA graph segments for the model forward pass
capture_breakable_cuda_graphs: capture breakable CUDA graphs for all configured token sizes by calling the internal _capture_all method during initialization
replay_cuda_graph: replay a captured breakable CUDA graph for a ForwardBatch and return the logits or embedding output
check_can_run: check if a ForwardBatch is eligible for breakable CUDA graph execution by calling the can_run method
build_capture_forward_batch: build a ForwardBatch instance with static buffers for a given number of tokens to use during graph capture
